design.name: 沙炮手
design.brief: The bandit faction's squat Ming-dynasty firearms-battalion (火器营) gunner: a short, stocky, barrel-bodied figure under a very wide conical woven bamboo hat (斗笠) with a red tassel and a sand-coloured cloth curtain at the back, a dark face cloth with two glowing ember-orange eyes, a quilted padded Chinese military coat (棉甲) with brass studs and cloud-pattern trim, several red-lacquered gunpowder gourds (火药葫芦) and paper cartridge tubes on the belt, the faction's crimson waist sash with the gold cloud-scroll emblem, a wooden back frame holding three glowing ember-orange dragon-headed rockets (火龙出水) wrapped in red paper, thick leather gloves with a separate thumb and four separate fingers, cloth-wrapped shins and heavy boots.
design.weapon: a short squat bronze Ming 'crouching tiger' cannon (虎蹲炮) with a tiger head cast on the muzzle and iron hoop bands, carried in both hands
